== HarmonyOS manual sessions identified correctly

The manual session viewer now recognizes HarmonyOS as its own platform instead of treating it as iOS.

- HarmonyOS sessions show the HarmonyOS boot logo and platform label.
- iOS-only prompts, such as the iOS paste tip and Apple system dialogs, no longer appear in HarmonyOS sessions.
- If a device reports a missing or unrecognized platform, the session no longer opens as an iOS session. An unsupported platform message asks you to contact Kobiton support, the session ends, and you return to *Devices*.

Android and iOS sessions are unchanged.
